relationships.subject: HDAC4
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results revealed significant upregulation of circHIPK3 and HDAC4 in both tissue and serum samples from OF patients compared with controls.

relationships.subject: miR-378a-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: Simultaneously, we detected a lower expression level of miR-378a-3p in OF tissues and serum than that in the control group.

key_findings: circHIPK3 and HDAC4 are upregulated and miR-378a-3p downregulated in osteoporotic fracture patients.
